text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ugh~... Seriously...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Too spicy, this is un-Arietty-vable...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Flower! Listen to this! We ended up 
getting assigned supplementary classes--!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A retest next week...? Give me a break. 
Total buzzkill...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Totally...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Palmer and the others... they sure had a 
rough time...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer. The thing is...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So, I was wondering if there was anything 
I could do to help.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because I think Palmer-san and Helios-san 
are at their best when they're smiling 
brightly!
choice_data_list: Didn't something like this happen before?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Before...? ...Ah, back when you made egg 
porridge...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, there's cooking! Thank 
you so much, I'll go ahead and give it a 
try!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(...I did say that, but a dish that cheers 
someone up, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huuuhm...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? What a coincidence, Miss Flower.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you are thinking up a dish to 
lift her spirits... A truly noble 
endeavor, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all. I'm just doing 
what I can.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: What I can do... you say? Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then, for your reference: root vegetables 
are currently in season. They're rich in 
vitamins and minerals, boasting high 
nutritional value. Eating them improves 
blood circulation and warms the body.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It will improve your metabolism just as 
much, allowing you to be more active. 
...To put it simply, it makes you 
energetic."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How about some dishes using carrots, sweet 
potatoes, or lotus root?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's amazing! This is so 
helpful! Thank you very much, Ikuno-san!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. I only did what I could. 
Good luck with your cooking!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...... ...Hnnngh, this isn't bad either... 
but.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I've got all the root vegetables, now for 
the main event: the cooking!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If I use everything, maybe a hot pot? 
Chikuzenni or nikujaga could be good, too. 
There are so many options, I can't 
decide!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hmm... A millet storm in the library...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Flower-san. I felt a breeze that 
reminded me of the fields—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ? Ah, could it be this...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, seasonal vegetables. At this time 
of year, the crisp texture must be simply 
exquisite...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! The crispiness, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When they're freshly harvested, I 
prefer leaving a bit of a crisp texture to 
truly savor the seasonal flavor.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"A way to eat it precisely because it's in 
season... I see, of course...!!"

On this day, I ran into Nishino Flower who 
was going to cook, and ended up watching 
over her in the kitchen like this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Crunchy crisp veggies...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you want them to savor the seasonal 
taste and enjoy the texture, I think 
serving it as a salad would be best.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Soaking the parboiled vegetables in cold 
water enhances their crisp texture...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, in this current season, isn't it a 
bit too cold?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, maybe something a little warm would 
be better.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right... But if it's a stewed dish, you 
kind of lose the crunchy texture...
choice_data_list:
Hmm... maybe prepare something other than 
vegetables?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That... might actually work!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I know! There's a dish that's absolutely 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With this dish, I'm sure Palmer and the 
others will get energized...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~... We're still doing this? Studying 
for the test...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"This is getting kinda tedious... Should 
we just head back?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hold on a sec! *Sniff sniff*... 
Doesn't something smell really good?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! I'm so starved, I can't even 
focus!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone! I brought some 
refreshments!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a crisp vegetable sauce over rice, 
packed with nutritious autumn veggies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way, for real?! You made it for me 
again?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I took some lightly boiled vegetables and 
topped them with piping-hot sweet and sour 
sauce!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's a dish my grandma used to make for me 
back in the day so it'd be easier to eat 
veggies!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, this is so delish☆ Wait, why is it 
still so crunchy even though it's hot?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I think my body's warming up! This is 
great! Feels like I can push for one more 
round! Thank you, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If I was able to help you two with your 
test studies even in the slightest, then 
that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes! With this, that retake is gonna be 
an absolute breeze☆

Later on, I heard that Mejiro Palmer and 
Daitaku Helios managed to get through 
their retests without any issues.
